local local_class = newclass("FoxEventCatBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 0.5)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1)

	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self.roar_usable_count = 0
	self.picked_action = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.phase_1_pick_rates = { 40, 60 }

	self.phase_3_pick_rates = { 30, 40, 30 }

	self.ever_used_roar_action = false
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HpChangeEvent), 'on_hp_change_event')

	self.current_phase = 1

	-- 배틀 존 가져오기
	local battle_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	local battle_zone = stage.Field:GetZone('present_cat_battle')
	if battle_zone ~= nil then
		battle_bound = battle_zone.Bounds
	end

	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "EventFoxCatSlash")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "EventFoxCatCharge")
	self.roar_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "EventFoxCatRoar")

	self.roar_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_bound)

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HpChangeEvent))

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, 'speed_down_persistent')
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_state)
end

function local_class:on_hp_change_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character) then
		local target_phase = self.current_phase
		if self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio <= 0.4 then
			target_phase = 3
		elseif self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio <= 0.6 then
			target_phase = 2
		end

		if self.current_phase ~= target_phase then
			if target_phase == 2 then
				buff_util.apply_buff(self.character, self.character, 'speed_down_persistent', -50)
			end

			self.current_phase = target_phase
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	-- Enter 처리
	if lua_helper.type_compare(next_state, CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState) then

		-- 체력이 60% 이하라면 고양이가 움직일때마다 화난 표정을 하도록 함.
		if self.current_phase >= 2 then
			self.character:SetEmotion(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:random_pick_using_prob(select_t, prob_t)
	if prob_t ~= nil then
		local random_value = unity_class.random.value * 100
		for i, prob in ipairs(prob_t) do
			random_value = random_value - prob

			if random_value < 0 then
				return select_t[i]
			end
		end
	end

	return select_t[random_util.get_random_int(1, #select_t)]
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()
	-- 3페이즈인데 아직 한번도 포효 배틀액션을 사용하지않았다면 포효 배틀액션 선택
	if self.current_phase == 3 and not self.ever_used_roar_action then
		self.roar_usable_count = 0
		self.ever_used_roar_action = true
		self.picked_battle_action = self.roar_action
		return
	end

	local selectable_actions = { self.slash_action, self.charge_action }

	-- 포효 사용 조건이 됐다면 넣어준다.
	if self.roar_usable_count >= #selectable_actions and self.current_phase == 3 then
		table.insert(selectable_actions, self.roar_action)
	end

	self.picked_battle_action = self:random_pick_using_prob(selectable_actions,
			self.current_phase == 3 and self.phase_3_pick_rates or self.phase_1_pick_rates)

	-- 포효를 안 사용할때마다 포효 사용가능 횟수를 증가시켜줌.
	if self.picked_battle_action ~= nil then
		self.roar_usable_count = self.picked_battle_action == self.roar_action and 0 or self.roar_usable_count + 1
	end
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then return end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HpChangeEvent))

	--변수 해제
	self.phase_1_pick_rates = nil
	self.phase_3_pick_rates = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("GuardianWolfBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 0.5)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CommonSlash:GuardianWolf")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "GuardianWolfDash")
	self.charge_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	-- 처음엔 슬래시 2번
	self.slash_repeat = 2

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.battle_action_count >= self.slash_repeat then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.battle_action_count = 0
		-- 슬래시 1~3회 반복
		self.slash_repeat = random_util.get_random_int(2, 4)
	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	end

	self:change_target()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('JumpActionBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		init_idle = 1,	--스폰 직후 대기
		idle = 2,		--점프 사이 대기시간
		prepare_jump = 3,		--점프 중
		jump = 4,		--점프 중
		jump_idle = 5,
		action = 6,	--액션 중
	}

	--스텝N번 밟고 할 액션명
	self.battle_action_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BattleActionName')

	--스폰 후 대기시간
	self.init_idle_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitIdleTime', 0)
	self.idle_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IdleTime', 0.2)
	self.max_idle_time = self.idle_time
	--스텝중 이동 시간
	self.jump_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpDuration', 1)
	self.jump_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpHeight', 0.6)
	self.jump_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpDistance', 2)
	self.jump_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpAngle', 90)
	self.jump_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'JumpCount', 3)
	self.jump_idle_time = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'JumpIdleTime', 0.1)
	self.jump_direction_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'JumpDirectionCount', 8)


	self.near_distance = 0.005
	self.prev_progress = 0

	self.anim_jump = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('jump', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false)
	self.anim_idle = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('idle', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true)
	self.anim_prepare = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('cast', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true)
	self.prepare_jump_time = 0

	--message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_event')
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end
	self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound

	self.battle_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.battle_action_name)
	self.battle_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.prev_progress = 0

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.current_jump_count = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.init_idle)
	self.prepare_jump_time = self.battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('cast')

	self.quick_jump = false
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == nil then return end
	if next_state == self.current_state then return end

	--state exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.init_idle then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
		self:on_end_jump_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_idle then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
	end

	--state enter
	if next_state == self.state.init_idle then

	elseif next_state == self.state.idle then
		self.current_jump_count = 0
		if self.quick_jump == true then
			self.idle_time = self.jump_idle_time	--빨리 이어서 뛰기
			self.quick_jump = false
		else
			self.idle_time = self.max_idle_time		-- 일반 뛰기
		end

		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_idle)


	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self:on_enter_jump_state()
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_jump)

	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_idle then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_idle)

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_jump then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_prepare)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

--jump 진입시=========================================================
function local_class:on_enter_jump_state()
	if self.character == nil then return end
	self.prev_progress = 0
	self.jump_destination_pos = self:get_random_position(self.jump_distance, self.jump_direction_count)
	if self.is_random_distance == true then
	else
		--가끔 벽같은데 둘러 쌓여서 바보가 될 수 있으니 제자리 뛰기라도 시키도록 추가
		if self.jump_destination_pos == nil then
			self.jump_destination_pos = self.character.Position
		end

		local direction = vector_util.get_x0z((self.jump_destination_pos - self.character.Position)).normalized
		self.jump_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * direction
	end

	self.prev_progress = 0
	self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.jump(self.character, self.jump_height, self.jump_duration * 0.6)
end

--self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(false)

function local_class:on_update_jump_state()
	if self.character == nil then return end

	--근처에 도착했다. 쉰다.
	local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.jump_destination_pos)
	if dist <= self.near_distance then
		self:change_state(self.state.jump_idle)
		return
	end

	--이동 제한시간이 지났다. 쉰다
	if self.time_passed > self.jump_duration then
		self:change_state(self.state.jump_idle)
		return
	end

	self:move_one_frame()
end

function local_class:move_one_frame()
	--https://easings.net/ko 나중에 보간 관련해서 참고
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration)
	local progress_dt = progress - self.prev_progress
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.jump_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.jump_distance * progress_dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(move_info.direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.Move, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.prev_progress = progress
end

function local_class:on_end_jump_state()
	self.current_jump_count = self.current_jump_count + 1
	self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
end


function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.idle)
end


--region Update
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.idle then	--점프 사이 대기시간 동안 대기 후 이동
		if self.time_passed > self.idle_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_jump then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_jump_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self:on_update_jump_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_idle then
		if self.current_jump_count >= self.jump_count then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed > self.jump_idle_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare_jump)
				return
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.battle_action_tirggerd == true then
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_tirggerd = false
				self:change_state(self.state.idle)
				return
			end
		else
			self.battle_action_tirggerd = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action)
		end

	--최초 대기 시간
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.init_idle then	--초기 대기 시간 이후 이동
		if self.time_passed > self.init_idle_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	end

end
--endregion

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if self.character ~= e.Sender then
			return false
		end --내가 보낸거 아님 무시한다.
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'HeadCrabQuickJump' then
			self.quick_jump = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion


--region Util

--360/N 각도를 무작위로 얻어 distance 만큼 떨어진 위치를 얻는다.
function local_class:get_random_position(distance, count)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return self.character.Position
	end

	local candidate_pos_list = pattern_util.vertexes_on_circle(self.character.Position, distance, count, 0)

	for index = #candidate_pos_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.zone_bound:Contains(candidate_pos_list[index]) == false then
			table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)

			--이동중 벽과 충돌이 예상된다면 제거
		elseif CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsMovementBlockedBetween(self.character, self.character.Position, candidate_pos_list[index], CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == true then
			table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)

		elseif self.last_move_point ~= nil then
			local distance = vector_util.distance(candidate_pos_list[index], self.last_move_point)
			if distance < 0.1 then
				table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)
			end
		end
	end

	--하나도 없다면 마지막으로 이동했던 위치로 이동
	if #candidate_pos_list <= 0 then
		table.insert(candidate_pos_list, self.last_move_point)
	end

	local random_range = #candidate_pos_list
	local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, random_range)
	self.last_move_point = candidate_pos_list[index]
	return candidate_pos_list[index]
end
--endregion



function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.anim_idle = nil
	self.anim_jump = nil
	self.anim_prepare = nil

	self.battle_action_name = nil

	self.jump_destination_pos = nil
	self.jump_direction = nil

	self.last_move_point = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

	self.normal_two_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "LaboseMonsterNormalAttack:BossTwo")
	self.normal_slow_one_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "LaboseMonsterNormalAttack:BossOneSlow")

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--test
	--self.web_action.MetaTable:set_phase_change()
	--self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_stomp_action

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))

	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

--공격 범위 체크
--공격범위는 distance로
function local_class:is_in_attack_distance(dist)
	--스매쉬액션 범위 이내면 true 아니면 스톰프액션 범위
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		self:change_target()
	end
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < dist then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_money_shot_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent), self.on_money_shot_event_func)
		self.on_money_shot_event_func = nil
	end

	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	--공격범위에 들어오면 state.none
	--state.none : resttime대기 후 50%확률로 배틀액션 픽업
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
		--픽업된 배틀액션 실행
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				if self.next_battle_action ~= nil then
					if self.is_normal_attack_combo then
						--combo action이라면
						self.picked_battle_action = self.next_battle_action
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						if self.normal_attack_combo_count == 1 then
							self.next_battle_action = self.normal_two_action
						elseif self.normal_attack_combo_count == 2 then
							self.next_battle_action = nil
							self.is_normal_attack_combo = false
						end
						self.normal_attack_combo_count = self.normal_attack_combo_count + 1
						self.time_passed = 0
					else
						self.picked_battle_action = self.next_battle_action
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.next_battle_action = nil
						self.time_passed = 0
					end
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					if self.is_wall_range_attack then
						self:change_action_state(self.state.approach, 1)
						self.is_wall_range_attack = false
					else
						self:change_action_state(self.state.search, self.current_rest_time)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.search then
		if self:is_in_attack_distance(self.normal_attack_distance) then
			--TODO:벽과의 거리 체크해서 벽과 가까우면 바로 공격
			if self.character.Position.x > self.zone_bounds.max.x - self.wall_distance then
				self.next_state = self.state.range_fast
				self:change_action_state(self.state.range_fast, 0)
			elseif random_util.get_random_value() > self.search_a_rate then
				self:change_action_state(self.state.keep_distance)
			else
				self:change_action_state(self.state.approach)
			end
		else
			if random_util.get_random_value() > self.search_b_rate then
				self:change_action_state(self.state.keep_distance)
			else
				self:change_action_state(self.state.approach)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self:is_in_attack_distance(12) then
			--TODO:벽과의 거리 체크해서 벽과 가까우면 쉬지않고 바로 달심 공격
			if self.character.Position.x > self.zone_bounds.max.x - self.wall_distance then
				self.next_state = self.state.range_fast
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self.current_state = self.next_state
			self.next_state = nil
			self.is_hit_dealy = false
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.range_fast then
		self:change_action_state(self.state.range_fast, 0)
		self.is_wall_range_attack = true
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.defence then
		self:update_defence(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.approach then
		self:update_approach(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.keep_distance then
		self:update_distancing_mode(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:change_action_state(state, wait_duration, wall_attack)
	--가드중이라면 가드 푼다.
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.guard_action and state ~= self.state.defence then
		self.guard_action.MetaTable.action_state:end_state()
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.is_start_defence = false
	end

	if state == self.state.search then
		self.current_state = self.state.wait
		self.next_state = self.state.search
		self.current_rest_time = wait_duration
	elseif state == self.state.normal_attack then
		self:start_normal_attack(wall_attack)
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	elseif state == self.state.special_attack then
		self:start_special_attack()
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	elseif state == self.state.approach then
		if self.wait_duration ~= nil then
			self.current_state = self.state.wait
			self.next_state = self.state.approach
			self.current_rest_time = wait_duration
		else
			self.current_state = self.state.approach
		end
	elseif state == self.state.defence then
		self.current_state = self.state.defence
	elseif state == self.state.keep_distance then
		self.current_state = self.state.keep_distance
	elseif state == self.state.range_fast then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.range_fast_action
		self.next_battle_action = nil
		self.current_state = self.state.battle
		self.next_state = nil
	end

	self.first_check = true
	self.distancing_mode_check = false
	self.is_target_action_start = false
	self.is_animation = false
	self.is_move = false
	self.time_passed = 0
end

--방어
--일정 시간 후 선택 패턴으로
function local_class:update_defence(dt)
	if self.is_start_defence then
		--방어중이라면 방어시간동안 방어 유지
		if self.time_passed >= self.defence_duration then
			self:change_action_state(self.state.search, 0)
		end
	end
end

--거리 유지
function local_class:update_distancing_mode(dt)
	if self.time_passed <= self.distancing_mode_duration then
		--적이 공격을 시도하면 방어
		if self.is_target_action_start then
			--TODO: 일단 몬스터의 공격사거리 안이면 방어시도하게 하지만 나중에 로보트의 공격거리를 받아서 해야하지 않을까?
			if self.is_animation then
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self.is_animation = false
			end
			if random_util.get_random_value() < self.defence_rate then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.guard_action
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
				self.is_start_defence = true
				self:change_action_state(self.state.defence)
			end
			self.is_target_action_start = false
		end

		--self.keep_mode_distance로 좌우 상관없이 이동
		local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
		if math.abs(math.abs(diff) - self.keep_mode_distance) > 0.1 then
			--거리 유지
			local dir
			if math.abs(diff) > self.keep_mode_distance then
				dir = unity_class.vector3.left
			else
				dir = unity_class.vector3.right
			end

			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = self.distance_move_speed * dt
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Left, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			if not self.is_animation then
				local ar
				if dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
					ar = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk_front", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true,
							self.walk_ani_scale)
				else
					ar = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk_back", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true,
							self.walk_ani_scale)
				end
				self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, ar)
				self.is_animation = true
			end

		else
			--거리 충족 특수 공격 진입
			if self.is_animation then
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self.is_animation = false
			end
			self:change_action_state(self.state.special_attack)
		end
	else
		--거리유지 시간이 끝나면 선택state
		if self.is_animation then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
			self.is_animation = false
		end
		self:change_action_state(self.state.search, 0)
	end
end

--접근 모드
function local_class:update_approach(dt)
	if self.time_passed <= self.approach_duration then
		--적이 공격을 시도하면 확률로 방어
		if self.is_target_action_start then

			if self.is_animation then
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self.is_animation = false
			end
			if random_util.get_random_value() < self.defence_rate then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.guard_action
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
				self.is_start_defence = true
				self:change_action_state(self.state.defence)
			end
			self.is_target_action_start = false
		end

		--approach_distance 까지 접근
		if not self:is_in_attack_distance(self.approach_distance) then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = self.approach_move_speed * dt
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Left, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			if not self.is_animation then
				local ar
				if dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
					ar = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk_front", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true,
							self.walk_ani_scale)
				else
					ar = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk_back", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true,
							self.walk_ani_scale)
				end

				self.is_animation = true

			if self.is_animation then
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self.is_animation = false
			end
			self.is_move = false
			self:change_action_state(self.state.normal_attack, 0, false)

		local random_value = random_util.get_random_value()
		if random_value < self.normal_attack_a_rate then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.normal_one_action
			self.next_battle_action = self.normal_two_action
		elseif random_value > self.normal_attack_a_rate and random_value
				< self.normal_attack_a_rate + self.normal_attack_a_rate2 then

			self.next_battle_action = self.normal_one_action

		if random_value  < self.normal_attack_b_rate then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.normal_slow_two_action
			self.next_battle_action = nil
		elseif random_value > self.normal_attack_b_rate and random_value
				< self.normal_attack_b_rate + self.normal_attack_b_rate2 then
			--combo attack
			self.picked_battle_action = self.normal_slow_one_action
			self.next_battle_action = self.normal_one_action
			self.is_normal_attack_combo = true
			self.normal_attack_combo_count = 1

		return
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent) then
		if e.EventType ~= CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage then return end

		local is_super_armor_state = character_util.has_active_buff(self.character, 800041)

		if is_super_armor_state and e.AttackTag ~= CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.HeavyAttack then
			--슈퍼아머 중 피격당하면 캔슬안한다.

		end

			return
		end

		if e.StunDuration > 0 then
			local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(0.5, 1.5)
			local stun_duration = e.StunDuration + random_range

	end

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

	self.target = fo

		search = 1, --타겟과의 거리 체크해서 이동 or 공격

	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.5)
	self.attack_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRestTime", 0.5)
	self.search_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SearchRestTime", 0.5)
	self.attack_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDistance", 5)
	self.move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveSpeed", 2)
	self.walk_ani_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WalkAnimationScale", 1.5)
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.normal_one_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "LaboseMonsterNormalAttack:ZacoOne")
	self.normal_two_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "LaboseMonsterNormalAttack:ZacoTwo")

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.is_use_strengthen = false

	self.current_state = self.state.search
	self.next_state = self.state.none
	self.is_animation = false

	--left방향만 사용
	self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.normal_one_action
	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.normal_two_action
	end

	self:change_target()

	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

	--액션거리 이내인지 체크
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		self:change_target()
	end
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.attack_distance then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.is_animation then
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self.is_animation = false
			end
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
		--픽업된 배틀액션 실행
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 0.5초 대기 후 서치로
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = self.attack_rest_time
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.next_state = self.state.search

			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.search then
		if self:is_in_attack_distance() then
			self.current_state = self.state.wait
			self.next_state = self.state.none
			self.current_rest_time = self.attack_rest_time
			self.time_passed = 0

			if self.is_animation then

			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Left, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			if not self.is_animation then
				local ar
				if dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
					ar = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk_front", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Option, true,
							self.walk_ani_scale)
				else
					ar = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk_back", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Option, true,
							self.walk_ani_scale)
				end
				self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, ar)
				self.is_animation = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self.current_state = self.next_state
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent) then
		if e.EventType ~= CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage then return end
		if e.StunDuration > 0 then
			if self.is_animation then
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self.is_animation = false
			end

			local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(0.5, 1.5)
			local stun_duration = e.StunDuration + random_range
			self.current_rest_time = stun_duration
			self.current_state = self.state.wait
			self.next_state = self.state.search
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.battle_zone_bound == nil then
		self.battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	local actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
	local index = math.fmod(self.battle_action_count, actions.Count)
	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1

	-- 보스 배틀액션의 BattleZone 셋팅이 필요한 경우
	self.picked_battle_action = actions[index]
	if self.picked_battle_action.SetBattleZone ~= nil and self.battle_zone_bound then
		self.picked_battle_action:SetBattleZone(self.battle_zone_bound)
	end
	self:change_target()
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		--- 어그로 가장 높은 놈을 타겟팅 한다.
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if(CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState))) then
		-- 배틀액션이 선택 안된경우 배틀액션 설정
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.time_passed = 0
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 배틀액션 실행
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					-- 대기시간동안 배틀액션 실행을 못했을 경우 다시 선정
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_idle_time then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1

	-- 보스 배틀액션의 BattleZone 셋팅이 필요한 경우
	self.picked_battle_action = actions[index]
	if self.picked_battle_action.SetBattleZone ~= nil and self.battle_zone_bound then

function local_class:change_target(target)

		end

	end

function local_class:exit()

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
			self:pick_change_state(self.action_next_state)
		end
	else
		-- Rest or init (배틀 액션 후 텀 주기)
		if self.current_rest_time > 0 then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self.current_rest_time = 0
				self:pick_change_state(self.rest_next_state)
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
			return
		end

		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 배틀액션 실행
		if self.picked_battle_action ~= nil then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				return
			else
				-- 공격 불가능하면 다음 배틀액션 설정
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end

		-- idle (보통 배틀 액션 사거리 안닿을 경우 or 직접 Idle State 전환)
		if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
			if self.time_passed >= self.idle_time then
				if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
					self:pick_change_state(self.idle_next_state)
				end
			end
			return
		end

		-- follow
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
			if self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				self:pick_change_state(self.follow_next_state)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

-- 최대한 공격 시도
function local_class:pick_change_state(new_state)
	if new_state == "Idle" then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	elseif new_state == "NormalFollow" then
		if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

--region 초기화
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

    self.character = c
    self.target = fo  -- Watch or MonsterWatch (첫 BattleAction에 따라 PatrolAI 설정)
    self.params_dict = params

    -- Monster AI State Common Variable
    self.max_idle_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IdleTime', 2.0)
    self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitialRestTime', 0.1)
    self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 1.0)
    self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 1.5)

    -- Heal State Variable
    self.signature_cooltime = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SignatureCoolTime', 3)

    self.can_attack_no_heal_target = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'CanAttackNoHealTarget', false)
    self.maximum_engager_count = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaximumEngagerCount', 50)

    self.is_move = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsMove', true)
    self.follow_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowDuration', 3)
    self.back_move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BackMoveDuration', 1.5)
    self.back_move_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BackMoveAngle', 45)
    self.is_follow_dash= CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsFollowDash', false)

    -- 공격,서포트 배틀액션 이름 리스트로 받기
    local attack_battle_action_names = CS.Utils.GetStringListFromDictionary(params, 'AttackBattleActionNames', nil)
    local support_battle_action_names = CS.Utils.GetStringListFromDictionary(params, 'SupportBattleActionNames', nil)

    -- O(1) 조회용 set 보관
    self.attack_battle_action_set  = self:make_set(attack_battle_action_names)
    self.support_battle_action_set = self:make_set(support_battle_action_names)

    -- self.battle_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.battle_action_name)
end

function local_class:dispose()
    --변수 해제
    self.cs_state = nil
    self.character = nil
    self.target = nil
    self.params_dict = nil

    self.attack_battle_action_names = nil
    self.support_battle_action_names = nil
end
--endregion

--region State
-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
    self.time_passed = 0
    self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:enter()
    self.picked_battle_action = nil
    self.battle_action_triggered = false
    self.battle_action_count = 0
    self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

    self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

    self:change_idle_state()
end

function local_class:exit()
    self:change_state()

    self.picked_battle_action = nil
    self.battle_action_triggered = nil
    self.battle_action_count = nil

    self.current_rest_time = nil
    self.time_passed = nil
end
--endregion

--region Change State
function local_class:change_idle_state()
    local idle_sub_state = CS.Oak.AIIdleSubStateNew.Create(nil, self.max_idle_time)
    idle_sub_state.ParentLuaBattleAIState = self.cs_state
    self:change_state(idle_sub_state)
end

function local_class:change_support_move_state()
    local ai_straight_state = CS.Oak.AIStraightProjectileFollowingNewSubState.Create(nil, self.follow_duration, 5.0, self.is_follow_dash)
    ai_straight_state.ParentLuaBattleAIState = self.cs_state
    self:change_state(ai_straight_state)
end

function local_class:change_attack_move_state()
    local ai_grenade_state = CS.Oak.AIGrenadeProjectileFollowingNewSubState.Create(nil,self.follow_duration, 2.5, self.is_follow_dash)
    ai_grenade_state.ParentLuaBattleAIState = self.cs_state
    self:change_state(ai_grenade_state)
end

function local_class:change_back_move_state()
    local ai_back_move_State = CS.Oak.AIBackMoveSubState.Create(nil, self.back_move_angle, self.back_move_duration, self.is_follow_dash)
    ai_back_move_State.ParentLuaBattleAIState = self.cs_state
    self:change_state(ai_back_move_State)
end

function local_class:check_move_state()
    -- 타겟 있으면 이동
    if self.is_attack and not self.is_follow then
        self.is_follow = true
        self:change_attack_move_state()
    elseif self.is_support and not self.is_follow then
        self.is_follow = true
        self:change_support_move_state()
    else
        self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
        self:change_idle_state()
    end
end
--endregion

--region target
function local_class:get_target()
    return self.target
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
    if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
        return
    end

    if target ~= nil then
        self.target = target
    else

        local new_target = nil
        local name = battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(self.picked_battle_action)

        -- 공격 배틀-액션 처리
        if self.attack_battle_action_set[name] then
            new_target = battle_ai_util.search_closest_target(self.cs_state, true)
            -- 서포트(버프·힐 등) 배틀-액션 처리
        elseif self.support_battle_action_set[name]  then
            if self:contains(name, "MonsterHealNew") then
                new_target = battle_ai_util.search_heal_target(self.cs_state, 1.0, self.ignore_self_heal)
            else
                new_target = battle_ai_util.search_heal_target(self.cs_state, 1.1, self.ignore_self_heal)
            end
        else
            new_target = nil
        end

        self.target = new_target
    end
    if self.target ~= nil then
        local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
        command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
    else
        self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
    end
end
--endregion

--region battleAction Change
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
    self:pick_battle_action()

    if self.picked_battle_action ~= nil then
        self:change_target()
    end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()
    local actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
    local index = math.fmod(self.battle_action_count, actions.Count)
    self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
    self.picked_battle_action = actions[index]

    if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
        self.picked_battle_action = nil
    else
        -- battleAction.HandleName은 못가져오는 경우가 있다.
        local name = battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(self.picked_battle_action)

        if self.attack_battle_action_set[name] then
            self.is_attack = true
            self.is_support = false
        elseif self.support_battle_action_set[name] then
            self.is_support = true
            self.is_attack = false
        else
        end
    end
end
--endregion

--region On Callback
-- LuaBattleAIState에서 실행
function local_class:on_finished_ai_sub_state(finished_state)
    if finished_state == nil then
        return
    end

    if self.is_move then
        if finished_state:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubStateNew) or
                finished_state:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.AIGrenadeProjectileFollowingNewSubState) or
                finished_state:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.AIStraightProjectileFollowingNewSubState)
        then
            self.is_follow = false
            if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
                self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
            else
                self:change_target(self.target)
            end
            self:check_move_state()
        elseif finished_state:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.AIBackMoveSubState) then
            self:change_idle_state()
        end

    end
end

-- 여기서만 실행
function local_class:on_finished_battle_action()
    if self.picked_battle_action ~= nil then
        local name = battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(self.picked_battle_action)

        if self.is_move then
            if self:contains(name, "MonsterHealNew")then
                self:change_back_move_state()
                return
            end
        end
    end
    self:change_idle_state()
end
--endregion

--region Utils
function local_class:contains(str, sub)
    return string.find(str, sub, 1, true) ~= nil
end

function local_class:make_set(list)
    local set = {}

    if list == nil then
        return set

    elseif list.Count then                    -- C# List, IReadOnlyList …
        for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do          -- ★ 0-based 인덱스
            set[list[i]] = true
        end

    else                                      -- Lua table
        for i = 1, #list do                   -- 1-based
            set[list[i]] = true
        end
    end

    return set
end
--endregion

--region Update
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
    -- 힐 끝나고 백무브.... 힐 시작 전 MinDistance를 위한 백무브..
    self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

    if not can_control then
        return
    end

    if self.is_move then
        if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubStateNew)) then
            return
        end

        -- Attack Move Sub State
        if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIGrenadeProjectileFollowingNewSubState)) then
            self:action_routine(typeof(CS.Oak.AIGrenadeProjectileFollowingNewSubState))
            return
        end
        -- Support Move Sub State
        if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIStraightProjectileFollowingNewSubState)) then
            self:action_routine(typeof(CS.Oak.AIStraightProjectileFollowingNewSubState))
            return
        end
    else
        self:action_routine(typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubStateNew))
    end
end
--endregion

function local_class:action_routine(state_type)
    if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, state_type) then
        -- 배틀액션이 선택 안된경우 배틀액션 설정
        if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
            if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
                self.time_passed = 0
                self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
            end
        else
            if self.battle_action_triggered then
                -- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
                if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
                    self.time_passed = 0
                    self.is_attack = false
                    self.is_support = false
                    self.battle_action_triggered = false
                    self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)

                    self:on_finished_battle_action(self.picked_battle_action)
                    self.picked_battle_action = nil
                end
            else

	-- NOTE: BattleAIDataBase Parse 이슈로 TargetSearchType enum 에 존재하는 값만 넣어야 함. 추후 수정 예정
	self.target_search_type = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'TargetSearchType')

end

function local_class:get_target()

end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 액션 데이터

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		--local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
		local new_target
		if self.target_search_type == 'Remote' then
			new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRangedTarget(self.cs_state, false)

			if is_unity_null(new_target) then
				new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
			end
		else
			-- Closest
			new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

end

	else

		self:update_circling_move()
	end

function local_class:update_circling_move()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))

						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else

					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then

			if self.target ~= nil then

		end

end

local local_class = newclass('LuaRoleMonsterBattleAIState')

end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	local actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
	self.role_action = nil
	self.battle_actions = {}

	for i = 0, actions.Count - 1 do
		local ba = actions[i]

		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(ba, typeof(CS.Oak.IRoleBattleAction)) then
			self.role_action = ba
		else
			table.insert(self.battle_actions, ba)
		end
	end

	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

end

			return
		end

	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self:change_target()

	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	if self.role_action ~= nil and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsAvailable(self.role_action)
	and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsAvailable(self.role_action) then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.role_action
	else
		for i = 1, #self.battle_actions do
			local ba = self.battle_actions[i]
			if self:is_available_battle_action(ba) then
				if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
					self.picked_battle_action = ba
				else
					local cp = self.picked_battle_action.Priority
					local np = ba.Priority
					if np > cp then
						self.picked_battle_action = ba
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_available_battle_action(ba)
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or ba == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(ba, self.target)
	or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsAvailable(ba) then
		return false
	end

	if CS.Oak.ITriggerBattleActionExtensions.IsSignature(ba) and self.is_signature_cooltime then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.clash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.duel_action = nil

	self.time_passed = nil

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_signature_cooltime == true then
		self.current_signature_cooltime = self.current_signature_cooltime + dt

			self.is_signature_cooltime = false
			self.current_signature_cooltime = 0

					-- 시그니처 쿨타임 처리
					if not self.is_signature_cooltime then
						if CS.Oak.ITriggerBattleActionExtensions.IsSignature(self.picked_battle_action) then
							self.is_signature_cooltime = true
							self.current_signature_cooltime = 0
						end
					end

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)

				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then

					else

						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	if self.on_damage_event_func then
		-- 이벤트 구독 취소
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
		--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self:change_state(nil)

	self.near_action = nil
	self.far_action = nil
	self.self_destruct_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- cs_state가 해제된 뒤라면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.cs_state then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 변경됨 이벤트라면 타겟을 바꿔준다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TargetChangedEvent) then
		self.target = e.Target
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target()
	--- 어그로 가장 높은 놈을 타겟팅 한다.
	local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_target(self.cs_state)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = new_target

	-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
	command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self:change_target()

	-- 딱 1인 경우는 자폭만 사용
	if character_util.get_hp(self.character) == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.self_destruct_action
		return
	-- walla, 살아났다제
	else
		self.need_to_die = false
	end

	-- 거리 기준으로 체크할 것이기 떄문에 대상이 없으면 생략
	if not self.target then return end

	-- 대상과의 거리
	local target_diff = bounds_util.get_center(self.character) - bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
	local target_xz_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_diff)
	local target_distance = vector_util.magnitude(target_xz_diff)

	if target_distance < self.distance_condition then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.near_action
	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.far_action
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	self:update_following_move();
end

function local_class:update_following_move()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = unity_class.random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- cs_state가 유효할때만 처리함
	if not self.cs_state then return end
	-- 이벤트 대상 검증
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then return end
	--- 이미 자폭 예정이라면 생략
	if self.need_to_die then return end
	--- hp가 1이 아닌 경우 생략
	if character_util.get_hp(self.character) ~= 1 then return end

	self.need_to_die = true
	--- 모든 배틀액션 캔슬
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions()
	--- 페이즈 전환 액션으로 강제 해제
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	--- 액션 사용 안한 상태로 변경
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_damage_event_func then
		-- 이벤트 구독 취소
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
		--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end
}

	-- 상태 초기화

	end

	if self.time_passed < self.attack_interval or CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action) then
		return
	end

	-- 공격범위 안에 적이 있다면 촉수 공격 실행 & 커스텀 이벤트 퍼블리시

				self.target = closest_target
				local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
				command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			end

			end
		end

	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.battle_action = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end
